title: Wine
summary: Wine provides 4 Camp Supplies, or can be drunk or thrown for Alcohol effects.

fields.Camp Supplies: 4 Camp Supplies per bottle. Both listed variants match.
fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Gain Alcohol for 2 turns, giving disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a permanent Alcohol surface in a 13 ft radius. Fire ignites it and Cold freezes it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
